name: r1_ClearList
notes: regargs: l=EAX; loop strength reduction (modern cl advances the entry offset before the store and addresses it with -0xB0)

name: r1_StateReset
notes: regargs: s=ESI id=EAX; float constants 1.0 and 128.0 stored as immediates by modern cl vs loaded from .rdata (same values)

name: r1_TimerStep
notes: regargs: t=ESI; float constant 120.0 stored as an immediate by modern cl vs loaded from .rdata (same value)

name: r1_HudSelect
notes: regargs: id=ESI; float argument -1.0 pushed as an immediate by the original vs loaded from .rdata by modern cl (same value)

name: r1_MatSelect
notes: regargs: s=ESI u=EDI; calls 0x0003E230 with ECX=u->list and 0x0003E260 with EDX=u->list EAX=t->count stack=entries

name: r1_MatDefault
notes: regargs: u=ESI; calls 0x0003E260 with EDX=u->list EAX=t->count stack=entries

name: r1_HeapReset
notes: regargs: h=ECX; size minus 0x44 emitted as add -0x44 by the original vs sub 0x44 by modern cl (same as dec vs add -1)

name: r1_EntFind
notes: regargs: prev=EAX a=stack arg 1 b=stack arg 2; calls 0x00052EC0 with EAX=&a EDX=a EBX=&b stack=b; original loop re-tests the same record (no pointer advance)

name: r1_DirDot
notes: regargs: mode=EAX p=stack arg 1 scale=stack arg 2; float result in ST0

name: r1_KeyStateD
notes: calls 0x000484B0 with EBX=a EDI=b; range check 3..23 emitted as unsigned (v-3)>20 by modern cl vs signed pair

name: r1_KeyStopD
notes: calls 0x000484B0 with EBX=a EDI=b; range check 3..23 emitted as unsigned (v-3)>20 by modern cl vs signed pair

name: r1_KeyQueryD
notes: calls 0x000484B0 with EBX=a EDI=b; range check 3..23 emitted as unsigned (v-3)>20 by modern cl vs signed pair

name: r1_KeyReleaseD
notes: calls 0x000484B0 with EBX=a EDI=b; range check 3..23 emitted as unsigned (v-3)>20 by modern cl vs signed pair

name: r1_KeyQuery2D
notes: calls 0x000484B0 with EBX=a EDI=b; range check 3..23 emitted as unsigned (v-3)>20 by modern cl vs signed pair

name: r1_TargetDot
notes: calls 0x0005BAC0 with EAX=mode stack=target then scale

name: r1_EntAge
notes: calls 0x00053230 with EAX=prev stack=a then b

name: r1_EntReleaseAll
notes: calls 0x00053230 with EAX=prev stack=a then b

name: r1_MatApply
notes: calls 0x0003E2E0 with ESI=s EDI=u and 0x0003E370 with ESI=u

name: r1_EntAcquire
notes: calls 0x00053400 with ECX=slot stack=a then b

name: r1_EntAcquireLocked
notes: calls 0x00053400 with ECX=slot stack=a then b
